blocks.content: Time to level up your code! Instead of creating one hole, you'll create 9 using a for loop.
A loop repeats code multiple times. You'll tell it: "Do this 9 times"—and it will create 9 holes for you.

items: In script.js remove your previous hole creation code (the part where you created a const hole and added it to the board).
Write a for loop that runs 9 times (from i = 0 to i < 9).
Inside the loop, create a div, add the class hole, and append it to the game board—just like you did before, but now it happens 9 times!

blocks.content: This is your first real example of automation. You wrote 4 lines of code and created 9 elements. Look at you, programming like a PRO.
